mentions.h: July 29th - 6 Mile Race versus Surrey Walking Club - Tooting

mentions.note: walker; competed in 1969 R.W.A. 10 miles at Morden; 57, joined Belgrave 1943/4; 10 London to Brighton races, fastest 9h.25m.07s. in 1953; Centurion No.246 in 1955 (21h.53m.55s.); runs a feeding station after Gatwick Airport; organised a Boys Brigade Walk in Earlsfield
recovered from illness; returned to the sidelines at Imber Court
Centurion No. 246 in 21:53:55, 1955; brother of Joe
walker, one of the Wilson brothers; seriously ill in Bolingbroke Hospital
died in July after a long illness; walking fixtures, sponging stations on the Brighton Road, work with youngsters
walker; died in his 61st year; 30 years' service to the club; a "Centurion"; organised Boys Brigade walking events and the Earlswood Common feeding station on the London to Brighton Walk
introduced Gordon Biscoe to the club
